charge_port.notes: Estimated: BMW i4 keeps a CCS1 port through 2026 (thinkEV 2026 eDrive40 lists CCS1; Lectron lists the i4 2022-2026 as a CCS-to-NACS adapter car; BMW Canada says native NACS is only on all-new 2026+ models such as iX3/i3). Same port assumed for 2025.

supercharger_access.notes: Canada: BMW says all BEVs except original i3/MINI SE become Supercharger-compatible by remote software upgrade and CCS cars use the approved Lectron Vortex Plus NACS-to-CCS adapter (access from 2026-04-08; i4 not named in the text read).
